exposure: prominent flow voids on fetal and maternal surface of placenta
focal interruption of retro-placental myometrial border
cohort: 9 pregnant women referred for MRI evaluation of suspected placental invasion who subsequently underwent surgery.
finding: Thick intra-placental bands, heterogenous placental signal intensity and disorganized intra-placental vessels were sensitive MRI features for placental invasion, while focally interrupted myometrial border was the least sensitive.
